title: Canonical Playground Example Cleanup
description: Remove duplicate playground example entries (empty example vs navbar No example). Canonical: navbar No example sentinel maps to empty exampleId; remove redundant .example("empty") manifest entries and ActionArgOption empty options; normalize __none__ in os-shell; update plugin handlers and tests.
summary: Canonical playground example selection: navbar "No example" is the sole blank-state entry (maps to empty exampleId). Added normalizePlaygroundExampleId in ui-react to map __none__ and legacy "empty" ids to "". NavbarExampleSelect filters manifest "empty" rows and normalizes on change. Removed duplicate .example("empty", ...) manifest entries from writer, puzzle (2d/3d/5d), draw, note, forms, mindmap, raster; removed cad "default" example that duplicated the blank state. Removed ActionArgOption::new("empty", ...) from writer, process, puzzle 2d, gis, shooting, note, cad. Updated setActiveExample handlers to treat only empty exampleId as blank (forms, sourcing, raster handler added). Cleaned example_labels overlays. Tests updated to use exampleId: "" instead of "empty".
